name: Spectra Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Spectra Industries Limited presently trades in automobile products.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is continuing with manufacturing activities of Brake Shoes on a small scale and supplementing its income by doing trading business in various items like chemicals, food-grains, steel, coal and various other Organic and Inorganic commodities. Company has secured dealership of Mahindra Navistar Automotives Limited for Heavy Commercial Vehicles & Light Commercial Vehicles and has already started one sale cum service workshop at Mira Road, District Thane and and two workshops at Panvel and Mira road (east) Mumbai.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
